children: SM Energy redeemed all outstanding 6.625% Senior Notes due 2027 for $416,791,000 plus accrued interest on Sep 4, 2026, and satisfied all obligations under the governing indenture documents. The redemption, conducted with U.S. Bank as Trustee, results in cancellation of the notes and related guarantees. This early payoff is expected to reduce interest expense and streamline the company’s capital structure.
